WisconsinKiosk · iPad home

Kiosk Home Avatars

Staff at the counter scan the home list for a face, not a name. Every person row now leads with that person's avatar, falling back to initials.

Side by side

Baseline = origin/main fd1b138f built Debug; after = this branch. Same created iPad Air 11-inch (M4) iOS 26.5 simulator, same GT_KIOSK_SCENARIO fixtures, dark, 1180x820 pt landscape crop. Fixture avatarUrl values are null, so the initials fallback is what renders.

Idle home

Overdue, due back today, ready for pickup, out due later.

What changed, and why

Status dot became a ringed avatar

Was

8pt dot coloured by section; person identified only by text.

Now

KioskAvatar (30pt inside a 2pt ring, 34pt total) in the dot's colour; initials fallback, 'SC' for shared.

Crew without gear shows faces

Was

Names and call times as a single text line.

Now

Overlapping avatars precede the same text line.

Verification

  • xcodebuild WisconsinKiosk Debug build on the created simulator: BUILD SUCCEEDED
  • npx vitest run tests/: 712 files passed, 1 skipped (5014 tests)
  • No payload change: the dashboard route already projects requesterAvatarUrl/initials for checkouts, requester.avatarUrl for pickups, and avatarUrl for crewWithoutGear; Swift models already decode them

Things to know

  • Photo rendering (non-null avatarUrl) is not shown: fixtures use null URLs to avoid a network dependency. KioskAvatar's AsyncImage path is unchanged and already in use on the Today tiles.
